title: "Worked Solutions to Concentration Inequalities"
subtitle: "Boucheron, Lugosi, Massart (2013) — solutions only, no problem statements reproduced"

Worked solutions to the exercises in *Concentration Inequalities: A Nonasymptotic Theory of Independence* by Stéphane Boucheron, Gábor Lugosi, and Pascal Massart (Oxford University Press, 2013) — for self-study. **Solutions only; no problem statements reproduced.** Work alongside your copy of the textbook.

Currently: all chapters (2–15), all 267 exercises.

Found a mistake? Corrections are welcome — please open a PR.
